_comment: Benchmarks for the monthly dashboard, copied from the skill reference files.
Per-site, because SKILL.md is explicit that benchmarks must not be mixed across
sites ('ห้ามใช้ benchmark ปนกันข้ามเว็บ') — SH666 is ~1 year old and Burmese, U89 is
9+ years and Thai, 88F is ~5 years and Thai, and their normal ranges genuinely
differ. A KPI with no documented value for a site carries null and is shown
without a benchmark note rather than borrowing another site's.
Sources, so these can be re-checked when the reference files are next updated:
references/deposit-detail.md — those three files declare themselves
'ใช้กับ shwe666 / ubet89 / 88fed', so their figures are site-independent.
Percentages here are already percentages (95.85 = 95.85%), matching the `_pct`
columns the pipeline produces. Head-count figures are people per day.
